headline: DO: 198 RENA IS STILL OPEN AT MIDDAY — the counter ask is two days old, your 7:30 fuse passed five hours ago, and the agreement dies Aug 14 · ✅ NEW SINCE THIS MORNING: the 195 Lake View REPAIR ADDENDUM landed at 7:31 with two documents on dotloop, so the inspection wait is over and the clock is now on your side of the table · WATCH: 5167 Lake Crest closes in eight days on a date that exists only in conversation.

notes: 🔑 EIGHTH RUN BLOCKED BY ONE SIGN-IN — EIGHT COMMITS NOW STRANDED. All three boards rebuilt and committed again; none can publish. The GitHub CLI has been signed out since Monday's migration and the Mac keychain still holds no credential (`gh auth status` re-checked this run: not logged in to any host). What your phone shows is Tuesday morning. `gh auth login`, once, in Terminal, and everything ships on the next pass — boards and a week of marketing graphics together.

✅ THE WARM-15 RECONNECT LANE SENT FOR THE FIRST TIME IN FIVE DAYS — AND IT ALREADY PRODUCED A LIVE BUYER. Five of the fifteen went out at 9:52; ten were HELD because the machine found their anniversary and ownership premises were false, which is the guard working rather than failing. ⭐ One reply came back in 82 minutes — a past client who wants something inexpensive on Lay or Logan Martin. That is the first reply this lane has ever produced, and it is already on your call block.

✅ TWO THINGS CLOSED THEMSELVES THIS MORNING WITHOUT YOU BEING TOLD TWICE. The teammate licence-compliance item dated today was answered by you at 8:38 and both halves are done. And 683 Flag did not just close — the payout is receipted and paid, which retires an item this board had been carrying as stranded. ⏸️ Separately: still zero ShowingTime events in twenty-nine hours, so nothing is owed and nothing was missed; agent outreach stays suspended exactly as you ruled Monday, and the two send-safety ledgers are still genuinely absent.

callBlock.why: STILL THE ONLY UNQUALIFIED YES ANYWHERE ON YOUR BOARD, and it is now four days old. Her buyer wants to write on the Altamont unit and is short on down payment, nothing else. ⭐ THE PHONE IS THE ONLY DOOR: with agent outreach suspended by your own Monday ruling, no machine will ever send this one for you.

🆕 THE FIRST REPLY THE RECONNECT LANE HAS EVER PRODUCED, and it came back in 82 minutes. A past client who wants something inexpensive on Lay or Logan Martin — a double-wide would do. ⭐ That is a live buyer who raised his own hand off a five-day-dark lane's first send. Call him while the email is still the reason.

🔴 THE WORST NUMBER ON THIS LIST: ZERO TOUCHES, EVER. Third buyer off your 1709 Fieldstone ad, re-engaged himself on a Sunday afternoon, and nothing has ever gone out to him in any channel. Now four days overdue.

⚠️ A PROMISE MADE IN YOUR NAME IS NOW TWO DAYS PAST DUE. Brand-new buyer off the 1709 Fieldstone ad, and the email that went out under your signature told him you would call him that day. That is the one kind of overdue that costs you the lead outright.

⭐ THE ONLY NAME HERE WITH PAPER BEHIND IT — you hold a SIGNED referral agreement on this seller, and the listing consult you booked never happened. This is not a lead to qualify; it is a commitment already made on both sides that nobody has finished.

New buyer off the Fieldstone ad whose email HARD BOUNCED — nothing you or any machine sends will ever land. ⚠️ If she does not get a call she gets nothing at all, and that has been true for four days.

New IDX buyer, and the phone is effectively the only channel — her only email is an Apple private relay, the exact address type this system has already watched bounce. Anything you send in writing may never arrive.
Asked you to call her twice inside twenty-five seconds, then followed with a slab-leak question, then named the issue herself in a later text. Three separate reaches, still no call back.

listings.status: 🔴 Active $450K — the counter ask is two days old, the 7:30 fuse passed five hours ago, and the agreement dies Aug 14
listings.note: 🔥 STILL THE ONE THING ON THIS BOARD, AND IT IS NOW MIDDAY. His second voicemail asked for a counter number and named his own ceiling out loud while doing it — a buyer negotiating against himself, which only happens while he thinks somebody is listening. ⏰ THE DEADLINE IS UNCHANGED AND CLOSING: your listing agreement expires 2026-08-14 — EIGHT DAYS — while the counter under discussion proposes an Aug 31 contingency deadline, seventeen days past your authority to represent these sellers. ⚠️ HONEST READ ON THIS MORNING: no outbound to either the sellers or the buyer's agent appears in email or the text relay — but a phone call leaves no trace in any lane this board can read, and your morning was demonstrably spent (licence item 8:38, team call 9:00, the 11:00 showing). This is stated as ABSENCE, not as failure. ⚠️ THE SEQUENCE IS STILL THE PROBLEM: you cannot quote a counter your sellers have not approved, so the seller call comes first.

listings.status: ✅ Under contract $369K — 🆕 THE REPAIR ADDENDUM LANDED 7:31 THIS MORNING, two documents waiting on dotloop
listings.note: 🆕 THE BIGGEST CHANGE ON THE BOARD TODAY, AND IT IS GOOD NEWS: the wait is over. The buyer's agent wrote at 7:31 to say the repair addendum was sent, and dotloop shared TWO documents on the loop three minutes earlier. ⭐ THE INSPECTION IS NO LONGER AN UNKNOWN — it is now a document with a response window, and the clock moved to your side of the table. Read what they are actually asking for before anyone reacts to it. ⚠️ THE OLDER THREAD IS STILL OPEN AND NOW HAS COMPANY: the ADDRESS-CORRECTION addendum has sat unsigned on dotloop for roughly two days with no signature receipt — so there are now two dotloop items on one file where the closing agent already holds the earnest money. ✅ Have both answers cold: the address correction is housekeeping, and the client-care fee is payable by the BUYER.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $295K — the 11:00 tour RAN this morning, and the read has not come back yet
listings.note: ⭐ THE TEST HAS BEEN TAKEN AND THE RESULT IS NOT IN. The first fresh booking this listing has taken since three separate buyers said the number was wrong went through at 11:00 — roughly ninety minutes ago. 🔥 NOTHING HAS COME BACK, AND THAT IS NORMAL AT THIS HOUR, NOT A FLAG. But it is also the single most informative read you will get this week, and it decides whether the $299,000 → $295,000 cut bought real traffic or one curious agent. Chase it this afternoon rather than waiting on the form. ⛔ Nobody has ever named a replacement number: every price-recommendation field on all three prior reads came back blank. Quote $295,000 only.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $164K — a named buyer wants to write, and the decision is still yours to make
listings.note: 🔥 The only YES on the board, now five days old. ⚠️ THE OPEN QUESTION IS UNCHANGED AND IT IS A DECISION, NOT A TASK: authorize a concession and trade a later close for a signed contract, or hold at list and let her buyer wait on a bonus that may or may not arrive. ⚠️ HONEST NOTE — you have still not asked your seller for a number, which is why this was deliberately NOT re-presented as today's headline decision: a decision with nothing behind it is theater. The unblocker is one question to your seller. ⏰ This file has also read AGREEMENT EXPIRING since 7/22 with no date ever pulled from the notice; that is fifteen days of an unread clock.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active $380K — four straight reads, every one blames size and layout, never price
listings.note: ⭐ SEVEN TOURS IN EIGHT DAYS ACROSS FIVE BROKERAGES and every price field on every form has come back blank. That is a photography-and-copy problem you can fix this week without touching the number, and it is far cheaper than the cut this traffic level would normally argue for. 🔥 The buyer-side thread that asked about competing offers is now on day five unanswered — still the only live buyer conversation this listing has. ⭐ It is also, separately, your best lead source: four of the eight names on today's call block came off this one ad.

listings.status: ⚠️ Under contract $899K — inspections done, appraisal clean, and the close date exists only in conversation eight days out
listings.note: ⚠️ THIS IS TODAY'S WATCH ITEM. No risk left that your side controls on the deal itself — but a verbal approval is not an addendum, and there is now ZERO PAPER ON EITHER DATE with eight days to run. The seller approved a move to August 20 through the office relay and confirmed by voice note; 8/14 remains the receipted contract date until something executed says otherwise. ⭐ Both dates land in August so the forecast does not move either way — this is a documentation risk, not a money one, and it takes one signed extension to retire. ⭐ Say plainly that the slip is driven by their buyer's own sale, not anything on your side.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active $559K — too high on the first read since the contract died, with an EIFS question behind it
listings.note: ⚠️ THE FIRST TOUR AFTER A RE-LIST IS THE READ A PROPERTY GETS GRADED ON, and this one came back too high with the worst staging score on file. The two reads before the contract both said JUST RIGHT, so the shift is real and recent. 🔴 A HARDER QUESTION SURFACED TUESDAY: there is no bond on the EIFS here. On synthetic stucco a buyer's inspector finds that independently, and it is a plausible part of why a contract already died once. ✅ RESOLVED TODAY: this was the one active transaction named on a teammate's licence-compliance notice — you answered it at 8:38 this morning and both halves are done. That risk is off this file. ⭐ THE STAGING 2 IS FIXABLE TODAY AND COSTS NOTHING. Fix that before anyone touches price.

listings.status: 🔴 Active $189K — the approved cut is now fourteen days old and still unverified
listings.note: 🔴 THE RISK IS TWO PUBLIC PRICES, NOT A SLOW SALE. A cut was approved two weeks ago with no receipt anywhere that it took effect in the MLS — on a listing whose only written read said the price was too high, and which has now gone twenty-four days without a showing. ✅ Two minutes to pull the MLS line and close it. ⚠️ That single written read is about to fall out of the fourteen-day window entirely, which will leave this file with no feedback history at all.

listings.status: 🔴 Active $364K — a read validated your price eight days ago and the seller still has not been told
listings.note: 🔴 DAY EIGHT OF A SELLER NOT HEARING GOOD NEWS. A price called JUST RIGHT by someone with no reason to flatter it, overall rating 4 of 5, is exactly what an out-of-state condo seller wants to hear. ⚠️ A validated price with no buyer is a marketing conversation — and you cannot have it with someone who does not know the price was validated.

listings.status: 🔴 Active — she called Friday and the tenant answer is now fourteen days owed
listings.note: 🔴 A CLIENT WHO HAS TO CHASE TWICE ON SOMETHING ORDINARY STARTS ASSUMING THE HARDER QUESTIONS WILL GO THE SAME WAY. Sixty seconds, whether or not you have the answer — "here is where it stands and here is when you will have it" resets the clock honestly. ⭐ She has since asked for two specific things in writing — the ceiling-height video and a colour question — and the video went to her last night, so the reason to call is now concrete rather than apologetic. ⚠️ The condo scope email you promised "shortly" is still owed.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active $1.15M — Sunday's open house is six days back and nothing has captured what happened at it
listings.note: ⚠️ YOUR MOST EXPENSIVE LISTING, SELLERS LIVING IN IT, and the only event it has had in a week exists only in your head. Five minutes of dictation makes it usable. ⭐ THE LAND COMPONENT IS PINNED NOW: the parcel runs 40 acres, and the one written objection this file has ever taken was about the land, not the price. ✅ A seller-side question on this address was solved into a call chip yesterday morning.

listings.status: 🔴 Buyer-side $2.35M — the largest number on your board, and your written position still has not gone across
listings.note: 🔴 FIVE ASKS AND OVER TWO WEEKS OF SILENCE. Your own message told the other side you would entertain a reverse offer — a real position stated verbally with nothing on paper behind it. ⭐ The written feedback they have asked for five times IS your negotiating position; writing it is not a favour to them, it is putting your number on the record.

listings.status: 🔥 New cash deal — offer 8/5 morning, seller counter by 5:12 PM, your counter back by 7:18 PM the same day
listings.note: 🔥 AN OFFER-TO-COUNTER-TO-COUNTER ROUND TRIP INSIDE ONE DAY, which is still the fastest thing on this board by a wide margin. ✅ THE ACREAGE BLOCKER IS RETIRED: the seller's own two numbers imply roughly 157.6 acres — the first acreage ever stated on this tract — so the deal can finally be valued. ✅ Your buyer authorised the next number by text the same evening and your counter went back two hours later. ⚠️ There is a small conflict between two acreage figures now on file; it changes the math at the margins, not the deal.

listings.addr: New Lot-Land listing — signed Monday 4:38 PM
listings.client: ⚠️ seller verified, property still unnamed on the paperwork
listings.status: 🆕 A signed listing agreement that no system in the fleet can see — day four
listings.note: 🆕 The signature is real and receipted; the parcel is not named anywhere in the document. ⚠️ Until it has an address it cannot be marketed, cannot be counted, and cannot be watched by any routine — it is inventory that exists only as a promise, and it is aging.

listings.addr: 225 Willow Point Cir · 3035 County Line Rd · 104 95th St N · 361 White Oak Cir
listings.status: Active — quiet, confirmed yours, and one of them has a listing appointment waiting on you
listings.note: ✅ THEY APPEAR HERE ON PURPOSE RATHER THAN BEING DROPPED — a listing that vanishes because nothing happened is how a seller goes ninety days without a call. 🔥 THE WILLOW POINT SELLERS ASKED FOR A LISTING APPOINTMENT AND NAMED THREE OPEN WINDOWS THEMSELVES — list one, buy another, and the ball has been in your court for ten days. Send a time, not a question. ✅ 361 White Oak finally got marketing after twenty-six dark days.

listings.status: 🎉 CLOSED AND PAID — the payout is receipted, and the feedback you owe the other agent is now openly overdue
listings.note: 🎉 ✅ PAID TODAY. This file had been carried as closed-but-unreceipted; the payday receipt came in this morning and the money is real. That retires it from the stranded-AR column entirely. ⚠️ WHAT DOES NOT RETIRE: the listing side asked for feedback three times and never got it. ⭐ The closing changed what that silence means — before it read as an oversight, now it reads as a shrug at the agent across the table on a deal you both just completed.

listings.status: 🎉 CLOSED 7/30 — day nine, and the money still has not reached the bank
listings.note: ⚠️ A closing with no receipted commission nine days later is the shape of a problem, not a delay — especially in a week where the business account has been the constraint every single day. ⭐ 683 Flag just proved these do land: that one was carried in this same column and paid this morning.

listings.status: 🎉 CLOSED + FUNDED — one clean, one with a stranded payout
listings.note: ⚠️ WHISPERING PINES IS STILL STRANDED at day nine on an open agent-of-record question. ✅ THE HALF THAT WAS BLOCKING IT MOVED THIS MORNING: the teammate licence-compliance item dated today was answered at 8:38 and both halves are done, so the administrative obstacle behind that question is cleared. Chase the payout itself now.

listings.status: 🆕 Buyer-side pending — the forecast found GCI nobody was counting
listings.note: ✅ Real money already on the board that had been missing from the count.

pipeline.note: ✅ THE COUNT IS SETTLED AND SHOULD NOT BE RE-LITIGATED — Monday's Weekly Pipeline & Forecast led with "THE COUNT IS SETTLED: GENE = 21. ACCOUNT-WIDE = 35," the item three consecutive weekly reviews called the fleet's worst bug. ⭐ 21 at day 218 is about 5.5 behind an on-pace 26.5 and annualises to 36. ⏰ THE REAL DEADLINE IS NOT DECEMBER 31 — at 60–75 days contract-to-close, anything counting for 2026 has to be under contract by roughly October 31, which is 12 weeks out. 🔥 AND THE ONE NUMBER THAT MOVES IT IS APPOINTMENTS: roughly 3.4 a week for 13 weeks. ⭐ TODAY FINALLY PRODUCED A CANDIDATE RATHER THAN NONE — a past client replied to a reconnect email in 82 minutes wanting to buy on Lay or Logan Martin, and he is on your call block. That is the first inbound of its kind this lane has ever produced. ⚠️ The three older shots still have not moved — a seller who named three open windows herself, a Lot-Land agreement signed Monday whose parcel still has no name, and a land buyer hunting for two and a half years. ⏰ AND THE LEAK IS STILL OPEN: two listings sit inside their agreement-expiry window, one of them eight days out with a live offer on it. A lapsed agreement forfeits GCI you have already earned.

money.note: ✅ THE FIRST CLEAN DAY IN SEVEN HELD THROUGH THE MORNING — nothing bounced overnight, nothing was returned, no fee was charged on either side, and the transfer you made yesterday cleared ahead of the day's withdrawals. That is real and it was earned in about ten minutes. ✅ AND ONE STRANDED PAYOUT ACTUALLY LANDED: the 683 Flag commission is receipted and paid, the first of the stalled closings to clear. ⚠️ TWO THINGS KEEP THIS ON ALERT ANYWAY. First, the accounting system's connection to the bank EXPIRED overnight, so every cash figure the books report is now unusable and materially overstated — the only trustworthy number is the one stamped by the bank itself. Second, two large recurring bills the calendar said would draft yesterday DID NOT DRAFT, which sounds like relief and is not: the calendar was wrong, the money is still owed, and nobody currently knows the real dates. ⚠️ Both were reclassified honestly this morning rather than left to look like a surplus. ⭐ THE MONTH ITSELF IS STILL NOT THE PROBLEM: August models above the survive line. September is the hole and it is still at zero — which is exactly what the appointment number on this board is for.

isa.decayPolicy: ⚠️ 51 OPEN, 21 OF THEM p1 — UP FIVE SINCE THIS MORNING, AND EVERY ADDITION CAME OFF A LIVE SIGNAL RATHER THAN A BACKLOG. ⭐ THE LIST IS WORKING AS DESIGNED, NOT ROTTING: a large block are contactless address-only seller records queued for re-check — records that arrived with no name, no phone and no email, correctly held at zero touch rather than guessed at — and the rest came straight out of texts, voicemails and replies you were in the middle of. 🔥 THE p1 BLOCK IS WHERE THE MONEY IS: four named buyers off a single listing ad, one co-op agent holding a live buyer who wants to write, a past client who replied to a reconnect email in 82 minutes wanting to buy, two separate land questions, and one seller you hold a SIGNED referral agreement on whose consult never happened. 🔴 THE NUMBER THAT SHOULD BOTHER YOU IS NOT 51 — IT IS THAT THE OLDEST p1 HAS ZERO TOUCHES OF ANY KIND, FOUR DAYS IN. ⚠️ Six inbound leads still cannot be texted at all: they typed a number into your own form that carries a DNC marker, and no rule exists yet for what to do with them.
isa.sweepCadence: Every ~30 minutes through the send window, plus the instant responder on inbound. ✅ THE SEND LANE IS DEMONSTRABLY ALIVE AND PRODUCED ITS BEST RESULT OF THE WEEK THIS MORNING — the WARM-15 reconnect lane fired for the first time in five days at 9:52: five sent, zero bounces, and a reply inside 82 minutes from a past client who wants to buy. ⭐ TEN OF THE FIFTEEN WERE HELD DELIBERATELY because the machine found their anniversary and ownership premises were false — that is the guard working, and it is why the five that went were safe to send. ✅ THE LEAD LANE HAS READ DRY ON EVERY PASS TODAY, verified two independent ways each time; that is a confirmed quiet lane, not a broken one. ⚠️ A REAL DEFECT IS BANKED AND UNFIXED: the label-based lead query has now returned a FALSE EMPTY four separate times while the sender query found live threads — every routine that trusts the label alone is reading a lie. The sweeps have worked around it; nothing has fixed it. ⭐ AND THE SLOW LANES KEEP CATCHING WHAT THE FAST ONE MISSES: the voicemail pull surfaces live callers the text pull never sees.
